question: Who is an acclaimed Kathak dancer with many awards to his credit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Birju Maharaj**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** is an acclaimed **Kathak dancer **with many awards to his credit.
 
• He is considered one of the foremost exponents of the **Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin gharana **of Kathak dance in India.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• He has also been honored with the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the **Kalidas Samman**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and has its roots in the traveling bards of ancient northern India known as **kathakars** or storytellers.
 
• This dance form primarily involves intricate footwork, spins, and expressive facial and hand gestures.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj has been instrumental in popularizing Kathak across the globe and has trained many students who have gone on to become renowned dancers.
 
• He has also contributed to Indian cinema by choreographing dance sequences in various films.
